chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about making up the days of Ramadan in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah, and whether to break the fast (of the make-up days) or not. He said: Make it up in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah, and break it if you wish.

key_terms.وَأَقْطَعُهُ: and whether to break (the fast/consecutive days)

ai.seo_question: Can I make up missed Ramadan fasts during Dhu al-Hijjah and do I need to fast them consecutively?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies the permissibility of performing qada' (make-up) fasts during Dhu al-Hijjah, a period often scrutinized for fasting restrictions. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explicitly permits breaking the consecutive streak of make-up fasts during this month, offering practical flexibility for believers who may find continuous fasting burdensome. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of ease (yusr) in fulfilling religious obligations, distinguishing between the obligatory nature of the fast and the method of its completion.
